name: Department of Archaeology — gazetted protected monuments, Rajshahi Division (district PDF lists)
organization: প্রত্নতত্ত্ব অধিদপ্তর (Department of Archaeology), Ministry of Cultural Affairs
attribution: প্রত্নতত্ত্ব অধিদপ্তর (Department of Archaeology), Ministry of Cultural Affairs
notes: Page 'রাজশাহী বিভাগের সংরক্ষিত পুরাকীর্তি' links one PDF per district (published 2024-08-31 for 6 districts, Pabna 2026-06-25, Rajshahi 2026-08-31; 153 monuments). PDFs are Bijoy/SutonnyMJ-encoded Word exports; text converted to Unicode by fetch.py (bijoy2uni) and spot-checked against rendered pages. Coordinates are the DoA's own GPS column (DMS / decimal minutes / decimal degrees, parsed); out-of-range or out-of-district values are not used (kept in extra_json). Descriptions (column 7) are not copied; only a construction-date phrase is kept. No licence stated on the site. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
